entries.statement: For source-standard LCA guards of size at most 8 in a width-3 decomposition of G, the uniform O(r^3) local signature bound follows from the main stw-3 profile conjecture.
entries.proof: Each guard signature is an r-profile on S. The conjecture bounds non-all-infinity profiles by C3*r^3*|S|; add one possible all-infinity signature.

entries.statement: The uniform O(r^3) local signature bound for every source-standard LCA guard implies the main stw-3 profile conjecture.
entries.proof: The LCA family has at most 4|A| guards of size <=8; each valid guard's G-distance vector determines the truncated G-distance profile on A. Sum the per-guard counts.

entries.statement: A local signature can distinguish vertices with identical profiles to A, even for a source-standard guard.
entries.witness: Tree ac,cx,cy; A={a,c}; rooted decomposition bags {c,y} then {a,c,x}. For r>=2, profiles of x,y to A coincide as (2,1); their signatures to S={a,c,x} are (2,1,0) and (2,1,2). The tree is a subgraph of K4.

entries.statement: The t=3 Joret-Rambaud Omega(r^4) treewidth lower construction refutes CS3 for partial simple 3-trees.
entries.witness: Its t=3 graph has a K3,3 minor using the coordinate-tree spine, three disjoint descendant branch sets, and branch sets containing the two terminal families of attachment paths. Simple 3-trees are planar.

entries.statement: Does every partial simple 3-tree satisfy pc_r(G,k)=O(r^3 k)?
entries.obstruction: The checked sources leave the simple-treewidth conjecture open; planar lower/upper bounds are Omega(r^3) and O(r^4). No eligible asymptotic counterexample or proof was obtained.

decision: Close CS3 as a separate intermediate direction: it is equivalent to the original conjecture up to constants. No successor task is enqueued.
